summary: Jordan is a cautious but gentle dog who has survived life on the streets. When he enters the care of the Foster family, he struggles to trust others and feel that he belongs. Fiona, the family’s wise older dog, helps Jordan discover friendship, courage, and the safety of opening his heart. After finding his permanent home, Jordan carries those lessons forward by welcoming other foster dogs. The story celebrates the journey from isolation to belonging and shows how kindness can inspire hope for others.
author_story:
Joe Dinicola and his family foster dogs while they wait for permanent homes. Jordan came to the family as a cautious, skittish foster dog who had difficulty connecting with potential adopters. As Jordan gradually learned to trust the family and their dogs, he became part of the family permanently.

Inspired by Jordan’s real journey, Joe wrote Jordan and the Fosters to introduce children and families to the patience, compassion, and understanding foster animals may need. He hopes the story encourages conversations about kindness, trust, belonging, and the difference people—including children—can make in an animal’s life.
